name: Error Handling — Complete
mechanical_verification: Trigger gate failures and verify proper error handling, evidence collection, and recovery path
prompt: call shark-gate action=evaluate gate=test passed=false to fail test gate, then check status and evidence
expected_behavior: Failed gate status changes to 'failed', evidence collected with passed=false, subsequent evaluation still works

verification_steps.action: Fail test gate: call shark-gate action=evaluate gate=test passed=false notes='Tests failed'
Check evidence: call shark-evidence action=gate-evidence gate=test
verification_steps.expected: Evidence shows passed: false for test gate

verification_steps.action: Retry evaluation: call shark-gate action=evaluate gate=test passed=true notes='Tests fixed'
verification_steps.expected: test gate now shows passed: true

pass_criteria.failure_recorded: test gate shows failed status after failure
pass_criteria.recovery_possible: Can evaluate to passed after failure
